short: Ojibwe: the Great Spirit or Creator.
note: An English rendering of Ojibwe gichi-manidoo, “great spirit,” “god,” or “the creator.”

short: An extinct genus of large Asian apes.
note: A genus of extinct apes. Gigantopithecus blacki, known from fossil teeth and jaws in southern China, was an exceptionally large primate that disappeared during the Pleistocene.
